programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 美好的工作
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《美好的工作》。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 讚美之泉
programme.desc: 一首既悅耳又有意思的詩歌,可以洗滌心靈,感化人心,創世電視帶你走進福音歌曲新領域。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-中華文明起源重溯與聖經創世記的關係
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#177粵
programme.desc: 悅驚見溢新相識的朋友「Mary姨」正是她親生母親群。悅和群不欲在溢前發難，扮作互不相識。悅暗中要群放棄接近溢。悅往找慶及朋商量，慶認為群此番回港必另有所圖，更要二人保守秘密，卻因此被躲在一旁的麗聽到。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#22粵普
programme.desc: 楊康當著丐幫長老們的面求娶穆念慈，準備接任幫主之位後與穆念慈成親。丐幫大會上，楊康誣衊黃蓉和郭靖是殺害洪七公的兇手，二人被點了啞穴，無力反駁。此時，裘千仞受完顏洪烈所託，帶來了金銀珠寶，希望丐幫南下。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 野生菇菌不要採，想吃菇的話，肥媽教你烹調，又示範製作外脆內腍的「椒鹽鮮菇」。肥媽傳授「趕烏蠅大法」之餘，教你「炒烏蠅頭」！一道「饅頭墨魚煎餅」如何令隔夜饅頭起死回生？還有「簕莧菜赤小豆扁豆煲瘦肉湯」。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 開學前後，手足口病的傳染風險會增加，這病主要透過飛沫、分泌物傳播，要留意手掌和腳掌可有紅疹，或口唇附近出現紅點。兒科醫生提醒除病徵外，家長亦要注意小朋友的精神狀態，治療這病則以舒緩不適為主。未有文字前，繩結可用作記事，其後卻漸發展為藝術，而每個繩結都附帶不同祝福。繩結藝術家細談初學時遇到的困難，並即場示範綁出「吉祥結」。「睇餸食飯」環節，傅季馨炮製「催淚辣椒皮蛋醬拌麵」，辣度可隨嗜辣程度調製。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 響螺烹調前先要去除多個內臟部位，諾懿示範箇中技巧，再用螺肝製作伴碟醬汁。雞蛋、鵪鶉蛋如何變成可愛雞仔？敏之巧手做出「一家大細」。嘉賓陳煒透露自五歲起開始入廚，更試過為二百人煮菜。她到來炮製豪華佳餚「西班牙紅蝦天使麵」，入味麵條配以「爆膏」紅蝦，好滋味！「龍躉兩味」也可變出非一般美味？諾懿炮製炸薑絲，伴以蒸龍躉一同享用。煒哥教煮自家刴椒醬，再運用熱石來烘香魚片，奉上一道既惹味又有氣勢的「桑拿魚」。

programme.title: 天梯#8粵
programme.desc: 世亮耐不住壓力留書出走。苗天說出販賣假犀角的騙子之事，新月指坤堯安排一切害世亮。濟民表示要聘請鄭嬌、廣達及三斤。愛娣帶醉流連，被流氓施暴。美娟服藥後咳出血被送入院。坤堯父子到賀家，當眾提出分家。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子因天時暑熱食慾不振，遂請教一向腸胃弱的山根如何解決，前者逐漸康復，又開始想吃油膩食物。小丸子遇到一位替自行車取名字的大姐姐，覺得其說法有道理，遂仿傚她替各種東西取名字。

programme.title: Hands Up粵

programme.desc: 萬里為保護唐芯而阻止其行動，母女因而鬧翻。另一邊廂，楊帆找來有勢力人士贊助玩具展，並透過Brian接洽EGO本地負責人，欲搶先與其商討合作。他又勸Brian暫時放下唐芯等人的恩怨，專注籌辦玩具展。與此同時，萬里發現Brian與楊帆及有勢力人士接觸，覺得有可疑而採取行動。其後，楊光查出Brian疑似收藏EGO絕版模型的地點，與唐芯前往查看時遇上麻煩。萬里得悉唐芯有危險，立即前往救人，其間遇上楊帆……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#25粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)幸如記起當天撞傷自己之人是誰，更懷疑對方的目標其實是家謙。啟榮不忿苓君始終偏袒家謙；不料苓君此時受傷昏迷，啟榮趁機加快部署。雪文想起曾拍到幸如被車撞的片段，欲以此跟家謙要錢。繼威則欲搶走影片換錢還債，追逐中，雪文撞傷昏迷……幸如終取得影片準備報警，卻得知家謙與曉彤被綁架！幸如依指示前往綁架地點，希望可救出二人，但家謙不知所蹤……

programme.title: 百花殺#2粵普
programme.desc: 汐和進京某晚，華雍冒充大理寺官員接近她，卻被她識破。汐和回到衛國公府，將蕭氏趕走，以報蕭靖陷害之仇。汐和進宮見皇上，並表明會親自挑選夫君。華雍約汐和單獨見面，期間得到汐和信任，將《胭脂錄》交到他手上。

programme.title: 玄戰直播粵PG
programme.desc: 另一位從預測股價考驗成功「復活」的參賽者，將與率先晉級的其中三位黑先知同場對壘。本集神秘嘉賓曾於2024年與「死神」擦身而過，到底當時發生了甚麼事？又對其造成多大影響？四名黑先知要各憑自家修為，探尋答案玄機。神秘嘉賓加碼再出題，黑先知們要測算出嘉賓攜來之物，以及其背後故事。經過兩回合比拼，獲評審分數較高的一位黑先知，連同觀眾投選票數較高者，可雙雙晉身下一階段的玄學激戰！

母親的乒乓球#1粵
programme.desc: 女童余卓穎於乒乓球教練郭一指導下，接連在館內賽勝出。卓穎不擅面對逆境，一次球賽落敗大受打擊，及後又與同伴起衝突而被郭一訓斥，她意氣下聲言不再打乒乓球。江芷昕跟女兒卓穎相依為命，本想開解卓穎，卻產生磨擦，讓芷昕反思母女之間缺乏溝通。郭一提出讓卓穎擔任一日導師，為芷昕進行乒乓球特訓，藉以幫助卓穎衝破心理障礙。特訓過後，母女修補關係，卓穎也重拾正確心態，再次於館內賽取勝，並得到與國家青年隊切磋的機會。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 睡覺時身體突然抖動或雙腳抽搐，可能是出現「睡眠相關運動障礙」。精神科醫生以睡眠週期解說狀況，成因主要是腦部鐵質不足？醫生細述有關症狀對健康的影響，並帶來治療資訊。入住兒童之家的小孩各有狀況，「同行大使」關心妍與兒童之家院長合辦音樂會，為孩子送上關懷，而心妍的女兒更會「擔大旗」帶領小朋友唱歌！心妍與主持黃劍文率先預演，在節目中合唱<陪著你走。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製家常小菜「XO醬涼瓜烙」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 「芝士龍蝦伊麵」味道與賣相兼備，諾懿提到龍蝦下鑊前要先插入竹籤，以免龍蝦肉變彎。他自製芝士醬有何秘訣？敏之示範在方包畫上花朵，將平凡食材變得賞心悅目！新一代「美女廚神」張曦雯登場，她擅長煮西餐，並選用三文魚扒及煙三文魚奉上「法式三文魚芝士派」。中、西式煮雞的做法層出不窮，諾懿以先煙燻、後氣炸的方式帶來「甕窯風味雞」。曦雯用雞胸肉炮製「意大利芝士焗釀雞脯」，身為「芝士控」的她原來對健康定義另有見解？

programme.title: 天梯#9粵
programme.desc: 苗天看見坤堯逼新月，美娟取出一封信公開坤堯的惡行，坤堯中風入院。世豪跪求美娟放過坤堯，美娟表示坤堯不再提出分家便不追究。新月發現苗天給世章寫的借據，頓感一線曙光。苗天往找新月，但新月卻到濟民藥行找他。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#178粵
programme.desc: 各人害怕悅破壞，要溢送群離開。悅趕回家看不到群，當眾向溢大興問罪，令溢終於知道「Mary姨」正是其母。悅數落群時，慶卻突然說出群遺棄兒女的原因。群終於與子女重圓，但群突然向溢提出，請他一起到美國生活。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#23粵普PG
programme.desc: 黃蓉為了證明自己是洪七公親傳的弟子，她用打狗棒法教訓楊康，彭長老等人提出如果黃蓉用打狗棒法打敗他們，他們就承認她的幫主身分；黃蓉和郭靖來到鐵掌幫，看到完顏洪烈已來到，決定先去鐵掌中峰取走《武穆遺書》…

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 貂蟬的眼淚威力顛覆三國，她向黎芷珊大爆自己在三國時代有千千萬萬個「分身」！康熙遺詔上「康熙傳位十四子」與「康熙傳位于四子」之爭，令宮中謠言四起，「大鑊密探凌凌一」找到宮中知情人士大爆雍正登基的內幕！

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 西施令吳王夫差神魂顛倒，最終助越王勾踐反敗為勝，她是怎樣從重口味的鄉下妹變成美麗的天后？慈禧太后曾九道上諭要徹查「楊乃武與小白菜」案，究竟一宗婆媳糾紛如何演變成奪命血案？CID兵分三路破解冤案真相！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 作為南半球的國家, 澳洲既是大島, 也是大陸, 海岸線延綿數千公里 我們沿著昆士蘭州東岸展開旅程, 它跟珊瑚海接壤 展示不同的天然美景、動物、建築及人類活動等等 此行可以全面體驗最地道澳洲生活

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥自由城是獨立運作的社區。擁有自己的法律、旗幟和獨特的生活方式。孕育了一個自由、民主和博愛精神世界。印度黎明之城 3300名來自世界各地的居民, 放棄了私有財產，貢獻自己的能力，為整個社區提供服務。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵
programme.desc: 李施嬅的生活品味人人讚好，眾女隨她來到充滿田園風的歐陸茶座，一邊享用精美茶點，一邊互訴六年來的姊妹情。昔日結伴旅遊樂趣多多，五女大爆胡杏兒的旅行闊綽事件！一眾好姊妹希望姚子羚快有「嫁期」，特意在澳洲教堂預演婚禮，場面既感動又搞笑。朱古力甜品讓女士們又愛又恨，六姊妹到訪位於菲臘島的隱世朱古力工廠，多款造型精緻的朱古力呈現眼前，埋藏多時的少女心霎時爆發。

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: 周柏豪、袁偉豪(Ben)出海往吊鐘洲感受異地風情，再到媲美布吉的甕缸灣浮潛，近距接觸海洋生物。柏豪曾任救生員，潛水卻是第一次！他們上水後邊洗澡邊談相識經過，是誰仍會登入ICQ戶口？二人搭營、劈柴、開爐，準備迎接人生第一次Camping，重點是要夠型夠瀟灑！不過，柏豪為此行錯過跟愛妻每晚牽手八小時，真大犧牲！喝着咖啡聊天，Ben提起當年選港男原因，而柏豪2019年榮升爸爸，最煩惱竟是走進產房的衣著！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 地球約七成表面被海洋、湖泊等覆蓋，更有數據指全球海洋的平均深度為3680米。雖然這蔚藍星體蘊藏豐富海洋資源，但人類似乎對探索深海世界缺乏興趣？谷主凱婷卻指出下潛需承受極高水壓、漆黑環境、極低溫度等，都是阻礙人類涉足深海的原因。位於西太平洋的馬里亞納海溝，是地球已知的最深海溝。凱婷細述專家下潛探索的故事，還會介紹生活於漆黑深海下的特別品種鯊魚、章魚，並嘗試歸納出生物得以在這絕地適應存活的共通點。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 濠玩夏水禮粵
programme.desc: Bob、金剛召集另外兩隊人馬展開對壘。瘋狂擺尾計次數，黃美棋、黃婉恩等美人魚玩到虛脫。化身攀石鐵人，深近視的陸浩明爬第一格已失手，楊潮凱卻敏捷登頂。伴隨音樂鬥快除十件衫兼做動作，阮兒自訂複雜動作可謂捉蟲；傅嘉莉極速脫衣除埋自家服！團隊合作運水盤，變倒水大報仇，朱智賢、劉溫馨更被指佗衰家。接力飲汁過三關，某成員過三關都唔識玩？要抵抗水花攻擊企上浮墊，做慣瑜伽有着數？豬隊友實至名歸，有人受罰前竟爆喊！

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵
programme.desc: 眼見圈中好姊妹先後成為幸福人妻，單身的姚子羚坦言對愛情有憧憬，但不強求！談到現時愛情與婚姻狀況，慰玲、天宇不約而同以中午來形容；自瑤卻稱是子時？年齡、地域可會是愛情的界限？子羚曾在澳洲讀書，回想一段異地戀，也認為只能接受年輕五歲的異性。主持們邊決戰四方城，邊談對伴侶同公司的看法。諾懿另笑言於家中佈置零話語權，天宇則堅稱不許另一半碰其愛車。食糊可向拍檔提問，諾懿想知自瑤如何看待頒獎禮「黑面」傳聞……

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵
programme.desc: 緣分天注定，婚姻要經營！玄學家李丞責細說玄妙之處，箇中顯露愛情智慧。每段感情都是人生歷練，關鍵在於有所成長。所謂打者愛也，被太太罵其實值得開心？諾懿笑言太太很愛他……名利不及家人重要，丞丞師傅坦言信任太太管錢，也談及夫妻相距十多歲的看法。面相揭示感情關係，眉毛雜亂反映易花心。眼大較感情用事，眼細則理智，慰玲卻詫異自己非大眼之人？子溢、諾懿另會憶述不浪漫的求婚經歷，有人更自揭婚宴當日醉到丟失婚戒？

programme.title: 智慧綠色未來：AI 賦能新時代粵
programme.desc: 人工智能如何推動綠色轉型？鄺潔楹、梁超怡走入「TVB綠色峰會2026」，探索AI如何賦能GreenTech及實踐ESG；並走訪本地大學及機械人公司，了解AI預測突發雷雨、協助防災，以及機械人節省資源的應用，剖析香港如何發揮科研、金融及國際市場優勢，推動GreenTech走向世界。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿翔與麥格奉御羅院之命去阻止阿渡一行人，他們找來化妝高手模仿子假扮成瑪蘿，試圖奪走鈿女，卻想不到阿渡等人竟然接納假蘿瑪嘅存在，兩人見計劃失敗，唯有召喚魔神，與阿渡等人展開激戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 教練黃永輝再次亮相「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，首先引領現場眾人鍛練爆發力。除了做垂直跳、左右跳之外，做出波比跳時，他還設計了雙人猜拳互動玩法，小朋友在家也可跟家長邊玩耍邊做運動。另會利用橡筋帶與水樽輔助訓練平衡力，黃Sir稱相關動作對大家日常上落樓梯都有幫助，可減低意外受傷機會。「動物好萌友」則帶來大熊貓爬樹、吃竹子等日常生活片段。竹子是牠們的主要食物，每日攝取的熱量大約相等於20碗白飯。

新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：健康誠諾書粵
programme.desc: 面對突如其來的重病，或是因長時間照顧患病家人而生的壓力，一份對健康的承諾與周全保障，無疑是守護家人與自身的強大後盾。主持賴慰玲邀請「星級」藝人陳展鵬、袁偉豪、張慧儀、黃翠如、孫慧雪，細訴作為照顧者或親歷病痛的心路歷程。除了主持與嘉賓的對談之外，節目亦邀請心臟科、腦神經科、婦產科等專科醫生，解說坊間及網絡的健康迷思，並提供全方位的醫療及相關建議，讓觀眾可為家庭成員，許下健康承諾。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：唱錢粵
programme.desc: 「復仇之夜」下半場，眾復仇者繼續輪流挑戰「落敗之歌」，能否「翻盤」贏得獎金入場券？Sing級唱將小肥、「爆機」素人Mani接力上陣打Monster，全力為復仇成功者博取更多獎金。另外，主持森美、李茵彤壓軸試唱，向《唱錢》系統挑機！觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高質音樂平台，一眾歌手有展示音樂實力的機會之餘，也可讓樂迷更深入了解歌手的音樂故事。節目邀請「人氣」歌手擔任嘉賓，由嘉賓親自挑選其喜歡的新舊作品，並即場演唱，分享喜愛曲目。而一些樂壇新面孔亦會亮相，透過互動交流，展現音樂潛力。此外，每集緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新形勢，還會帶來不同歌手、創作人或製作人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至音樂業界的人和事。

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 大蒜採收後容易變壞，甘肅農民遂製成蒜辮晾曬。金銀蒜是海鮮的絕佳搭配；當蒜經醋低溫醃製，又可轉化為風味獨特的臘八蒜。羅馬尼亞有廚師亦擅長以蒜入饌，煮湯、配多士都別具心得。魔芋內含毒素，經特別處理卻口感脆彈，與甜、鹹、酸、辣皆可完美融合。八月的湖北，有一種名為陽荷的食材出土，需及時採摘，方能鎖住爽嫩口感。薑是福建名菜薑母鴨的靈魂食材，經兩小時燜煮，鴨肉的鮮味，與薑的溫潤辛辣，交織出令食客鍾情的滋味。

programme.title: 香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵
programme.desc: 孫佳逸、黃凱彤於全港乒乓球排名賽稱王封后，二人感受如何？凱彤也談及兼顧運動與學業的挑戰。港超球隊大埔的陣容經歷不少變動，也迎來新贊助商，陳肇鈞、謝家榮等球員暢談賽季目標；還有港超比拼精華。中國電單車製造商張雪訪港，細談對電單車的熱愛，及品牌對中國、海外賽車壇的改變。港隊為征戰匹克球世界盃誓師，羽球前名將陳念慈再披戰甲。名古屋亞運將揭幕，港隊舉行授旗儀式。另送上粉嶺高球精英賽戰報，以及港隊展覽消息。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
飛虎3壯志英雄#1粵PG
programme.desc: Ｏ記跟蹤沛國軍火商到演唱會進行交易，期間沛國流亡公主與同黨企圖搶奪懷疑裝有軍火的手提箱，並發生槍戰，Ｏ記要求飛虎隊支援；碰巧現場有阿軒等飛虎隊成員被脅持做人質，范Sir要求阿軒等人裡應外合，救出所有人質。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 兩個小生去Camping粵
programme.desc: 周柏豪、袁偉豪(Ben)出海往吊鐘洲感受異地風情，再到媲美布吉的甕缸灣浮潛，近距接觸海洋生物。柏豪曾任救生員，潛水卻是第一次！他們上水後邊洗澡邊談相識經過，是誰仍會登入ICQ戶口？二人搭營、劈柴、開爐，準備迎接人生第一次Camping，重點是要夠型夠瀟灑！不過，柏豪為此行錯過跟愛妻每晚牽手八小時，真大犧牲！喝着咖啡聊天，Ben提起當年選港男原因，而柏豪2019年榮升爸爸，最煩惱竟是走進產房的衣著！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 地球約七成表面被海洋、湖泊等覆蓋，更有數據指全球海洋的平均深度為3680米。雖然這蔚藍星體蘊藏豐富海洋資源，但人類似乎對探索深海世界缺乏興趣？谷主凱婷卻指出下潛需承受極高水壓、漆黑環境、極低溫度等，都是阻礙人類涉足深海的原因。位於西太平洋的馬里亞納海溝，是地球已知的最深海溝。凱婷細述專家下潛探索的故事，還會介紹生活於漆黑深海下的特別品種鯊魚、章魚，並嘗試歸納出生物得以在這絕地適應存活的共通點。

programme.title: 胡說八道真情假期粵
programme.desc: 李施嬅的生活品味人人讚好，眾女隨她來到充滿田園風的歐陸茶座，一邊享用精美茶點，一邊互訴六年來的姊妹情。昔日結伴旅遊樂趣多多，五女大爆胡杏兒的旅行闊綽事件！一眾好姊妹希望姚子羚快有「嫁期」，特意在澳洲教堂預演婚禮，場面既感動又搞笑。朱古力甜品讓女士們又愛又恨，六姊妹到訪位於菲臘島的隱世朱古力工廠，多款造型精緻的朱古力呈現眼前，埋藏多時的少女心霎時爆發。

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵
programme.desc: 眼見圈中好姊妹先後成為幸福人妻，單身的姚子羚坦言對愛情有憧憬，但不強求！談到現時愛情與婚姻狀況，慰玲、天宇不約而同以中午來形容；自瑤卻稱是子時？年齡、地域可會是愛情的界限？子羚曾在澳洲讀書，回想一段異地戀，也認為只能接受年輕五歲的異性。主持們邊決戰四方城，邊談對伴侶同公司的看法。諾懿另笑言於家中佈置零話語權，天宇則堅稱不許另一半碰其愛車。食糊可向拍檔提問，諾懿想知自瑤如何看待頒獎禮「黑面」傳聞……

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵
programme.desc: 緣分天注定，婚姻要經營！玄學家李丞責細說玄妙之處，箇中顯露愛情智慧。每段感情都是人生歷練，關鍵在於有所成長。所謂打者愛也，被太太罵其實值得開心？諾懿笑言太太很愛他……名利不及家人重要，丞丞師傅坦言信任太太管錢，也談及夫妻相距十多歲的看法。面相揭示感情關係，眉毛雜亂反映易花心。眼大較感情用事，眼細則理智，慰玲卻詫異自己非大眼之人？子溢、諾懿另會憶述不浪漫的求婚經歷，有人更自揭婚宴當日醉到丟失婚戒？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 丹麥自由城是獨立運作的社區。擁有自己的法律、旗幟和獨特的生活方式。孕育了一個自由、民主和博愛精神世界。印度黎明之城 3300名來自世界各地的居民, 放棄了私有財產，貢獻自己的能力，為整個社區提供服務。

programme.title: 細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 作為南半球的國家, 澳洲既是大島, 也是大陸, 海岸線延綿數千公里 我們沿著昆士蘭州東岸展開旅程, 它跟珊瑚海接壤 展示不同的天然美景、動物、建築及人類活動等等 此行可以全面體驗最地道澳洲生活

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜為奪下豪門不擇手段！】人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象。出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友。當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨、正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始。

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人
programme.desc: 【母親宣布「卒婚」引發家庭風暴父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密】故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開。母親突然宣佈要「卒婚」，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密。大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人。小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密。「像外人一樣的家人」間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇。

programme.title: 陌生人(完)
programme.desc: 【MOD首播】【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 紙之月
programme.desc: 【完美善良主婦為小王盜用公款!尋找自由只是為了空虛的愛?】講述家庭主婦劉怡華（金瑞亨飾）在婚姻中得不到丈夫關心，日復一日過著枯燥乏味的生活，她開始復職到銀行上班後，想找回自身的價值。原本頗得客戶信賴，不過在一次意外挪用客戶的錢後，她從中嚐到自由的滋味，接著陷入無法自拔的漩渦中。《夏娃的醜聞》裕善將飾演她的閨蜜柳秋天、《邪門》徐令姬飾演想躋身上流社會的家庭主婦。此片改編自日本小說，其日本電視及電影版在日本得獎無數。

programme.title: 向風而行(完)
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君(完)
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 行動電源出發吧
programme.desc: 【不插電的戶外實境節目，重新找回心的連結！！】充滿冒險與成長的戶外實境節目，由侯彥西、陳妤帶領一群新人演員，拋開日常科技，踏上從「心」出發的旅程。山林間的挑戰、露營體驗等，讓成員彼此扶持坦誠交流，重新找回與人相處的真實感動。每一次困難互助，都化作心靈的充電，讓旅行不只是冒險，更是成長與情感的累積，他們成為彼此的「行動電源」，燃亮內心最真摯的力量與溫暖。

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 水龍吟
programme.desc: 【羅雲熙尋找弒師真相的亡命追途，改寫江湖的命運！！】十年前，唐儷辭親眼目睹師門覆滅，卻被誣陷成弒師兇手，從天之驕子淪為人人喊打的罪人背負沉冤，只為查清那場血案背後真正的黑手。多年後，他帶著刻入骨血的信念重返江湖。為尋找真相，潛入暗勢力盤踞的「十三樓」，捲入武林與朝野交織的陰謀；與此同時，他結識池雲、鍾春髻等真心相伴之人，也在危機四伏的旅途中重新學會信任與牽掛。

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！】最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人。為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.desc: Rookie is a curious little robot who loves making friends, discovering new things, and having fun with music, magic, animals, and more. Every day is a new adventure for Rookie—whether he’s chasing a bouncing ball, exploring the stars, or learning how something works. He’s always ready to laugh, try again when things get tricky, and share big smiles with the friends he meets along the way. With Rookie, even the smallest moments become exciting discoveries!

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch tries his hand at stunt flying, but the Grimbots are unimpressed, giving him a unanimous thumbs down. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters enjoy the peaceful nighttime views of the Avenue of the Baobabs in Madagascar - a stand of trees known as 'the upside down trees' because their branches look like roots, reaching up into the sky.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Carrot

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Watermelon

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Monstertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea creates an evil version of her nemesis, Supertato. With the help of her hench-Cobs, Evil Pea makes a big, green lumbering spud that she names Monstertato!

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Honk Honk
programme.desc: The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' in the distance and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives the Teletubbies across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - House
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say house and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different houses; a small house, a tall house and a hen house! There's a lighthouse, a bright house, a bee house and a tree house. And of course, the most important house of all, 'My house!' The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Messy Has a Hoot
programme.desc: Messy and his friends go on a camping trip in OKIDO Forest with Tweedie the Explorer and meet a few more nocturnal animals than they bargained for.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Breakdown Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan the ferry can't shut his engine off, so he's speeding out of control around the lake. How will Mojo and Bo get aboard to take control and steer Bryan to safety?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Obstacle Course
programme.desc: Mum sets up a backyard obstacle course just for fun, but Dad wants to race! Now the kids are determined to win by any means necessary.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Bedroom
programme.desc: Bluey is excited to get her own room. But when bed time comes, she misses Bingo more than she expected and must find a way to stay in touch with her sister.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge

The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys f

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Heads For Sale
programme.desc: Hua is an upright and brave swordswoman who will stand up against villains and do anything for Luo, the man she loves. When Luo is sent to jail by the corrupted police, she sets out to free him and did not hesitate to chop off two bodyguards' heads. In the process, she also stumbles across an old enemy of her father who is back seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber(1977)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman "Golden Swallow” is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar “Drunken Cat” who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kong's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: Two Champions of Shaolin
programme.desc: Set in the Qing Dynasty, the Shaolin clan wants to overthrow Qing and restore the Ming Dynasty, while the Wudang clan is backed by the Qing government. The two renowned clans eventually set themselves up against each other, and a series of vicious fighting has just begun...

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Poor scholar Lin is engaged to a wealthy family's daughter, but her father looks down on him due to his family's background. Before leaving for the Imperial Examination, Lin visits his fiancee, only to discover a maid dead in blood. When his bloody handprint is found at the scene, he becomes the prime suspect. Can Justice Bao prove his innocence?

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Twin Swords
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his wife Gan Lian Zhu are the famous “Twin Swords” in the martial arts world. One day, they stumble upon a kidnapping plot at the Red Lotus Temple and Lian Zhu is held captive. Wu successfully escapes to find the Gan family for help, not knowing that he is sending them into an ambush by the kidnappers. Can he finally save Lian Zhu?

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Network News

programme.title: Treasures Found

programme.title: Qin Ai De Hai Zi Men - EP1
programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist- The Return Of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: In 1920s Shanghai, Chen Zhen goes undercover as a businessman to expose a mob boss's collaboration with the Japanese. While gaining his trust, he must also combat a wave of assassins sent by a brutal Japanese general. Fighting from the shadows in a black mask, he allies with a police captain to protect the city's patriots with his formidable fists.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: The Fate of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death. Since then, she sets out to search for the many reincarnations of Dao Qing over hundreds of years to help him reverse the situation…

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation…

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong’s Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur…

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar’s gang when he saves the gang’s elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a “super pill” invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B’s superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Yan is a police mole in the triad and joined them before he graduated from the police academy, while Ming is a triad mole in the police since young. Leading parallel lives, both men feel increasingly trapped in their false surroundings, and a series of cat-and-mouse chases ensue as both the triad and the police compete to uncover the other’s mole.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian arms dealer to locate and destroy a cache of munitions. However, when he finally finds them, he is attacked by unknown gangsters and must team up with his partner to recover the weapons and prevent a disaster.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong’s biggest stars

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Fight Back to School
programme.desc: SDU officer Chow Sing Sing goes undercover at a school to locate a missing gun. With his partner Tat, he successfully recovers the weapon, only to stumble upon a munitions smuggling ring. In retaliation, the smugglers storm the school and take students hostage, forcing Sing to risk everything to save them.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong detective Eddie dies while rescuing a mystical child during an international search for a human trafficking syndicate. Revived by the sacred Medallion, he gains extraordinary healing powers. However, when his ruthless nemesis also seizes its power, Eddie must storm a sinister castle and fight in a brutal battle for survival.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao’s house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao’s descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Angor Management
programme.desc: Jim and Strickler team up to bring down Angor Rot Meanwhile the Gnome returns with important information regarding Baby Enrique.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Night To Remember
programme.desc: Jim must convince Strickler to cut the bond to his mom while Claire and Toby sneak into his office during the Spring Fling Dance for the incantation.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - The Big Sleep
programme.desc: Aja and Krel travel into their parents’ memories in pursuit of Morando – and the truth about Gaylen’s Core. But when the King and Queen’s lives are jeopardized, a trusted ally makes a sacrifice that will change the team forever.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Race to Trollmarket
programme.desc: With their parents nearly regenerated and Morando in pursuit of Gaylen’s Core, Aja, Krel, and Vex unite with Toby and Arrgh on a quest into the depths of Trollmarket to unearth the relic before it ends up in the wrong hands.

programme.title: 3Below: Tales of Arcadia S1 - A Glorious End, Part One
programme.desc: Armed with the power of Gaylen's Core, Morando's forces attack Arcadia as the Royals fight to protect their lives and their adopted Earth home.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Killahead, Part Two
programme.desc: With the fateful battle underway, every hero must do their part to stop the Arcane Order, banish Gunmar and ensure that history plays out as it should.

programme.title: Wizards: Tales of Arcadia S1 - Wizard Underground
programme.desc: After returning to the 21st century, Jim makes a surprising sacrifice ... and a familiar face joins the fight. The Green Knight finally reveals himself.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Tip's Deep Dish Garbage Day
programme.desc: When Tip loses her voice, Oh finds a way to use his own voice to talk to her crush Keanu; Oh invents a way to redo yesterday so Tip can redeem a rotten day.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Very Foreign Exchange Student Pig's Tail
programme.desc: Tip's new friend, the Roidian, stays with the Tuccis in hopes of learning from humans; Tip accidentally swaps bodies with Pig.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - The Compst Elf Meet Ya at the Stump
programme.desc: The streets get trashy when Archibald misinforms folks about compost. Archibald and his pals rally when their favorite hangout is threatened.

programme.title: Archibald's Next Big Thing S1 - A Taste of Crackridge The Bird and the Bee
programme.desc: Archibald's Souper Stew is a surprise hit with the residents of Crackridge. Archibald and his pal Bea reminisce about how they first met.

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - A Knight's Tail
programme.desc: Huzzah! Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-owd are Knights in Training, and they head into the dollhouse for the Royal Knighting Ceremony. But it turns out that someone's locked King Catnip in the tower and without him they'll have to cancel the Royal Knighting Ceremony! It's up to the Knights in Training to solve the mystery and save King Catnip by performing acts of knighthood. For our Cat of the Day, Pandy makes a shield craft!

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - Tea Time’s Up Barks, Baths, and Beyond
programme.desc: When Athena thinks Lola no longer wants to have their weekly tea party, a tradition they’ve had as long as Athena can remember, Athena tries everything she can to get Lola to have another one. When Tracy and Harper accidentally leave Wilford at home, on their way to the Fairhaven Pet Get Together, it’s up to the Dew Drops to get him to the park on time. But because it just rained, getting Wilford there clean proves to be a challenge.

programme.title: Dew Drops Diaries S1 - The Secret Ingredient Delete That Dew!
programme.desc: When Harper is missing an ingredient to make her Mom’s favorite dessert on Mother’s Day, Eden enlists the help of her fellow Dew Drops to do an emergency city-wide ingredient search! When Marcus records a video of his inventions, Phoebe gets caught on camera and must erase the footage before Marcus sees, or her Dew Drop cover will be blown!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S2 - Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when there's no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the "Whoopsies!" Song.

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - Happy Snooze Year
programme.desc: When Melman learns that his friends stay up late every New Year’s Eve to watch the ball drop in Times Square, he’s determined to stay up with the big kids and join the fun. But as the night goes on, an exhausted Melman causes total chaos for himself and the gang. He ultimately realizes that missing your bedtime isn’t all its cracked up to be

programme.title: Madagascar: A Little Wild S1 - A Tadpole Tale
programme.desc: When fun-loving, water-dwelling tadpole LALA shows up in Gloria’s tank, the two become underwater besties! But when Molly wants Gloria to spend “Palentine’s Day” with her, Gloria can’t admit she’s already made plans to spend it with her “land” friends and runs herself ragged running back and forth between Molly and the gang. Gloria’s attempts to make everyone happy backfire, leading her to learn that she can have different groups of friends, and it’s okay to play with them one at a time, or all

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Message in a Bubble Glitteretti
programme.desc: Kelp has a new trick with his bubbles: he can have his friends put voice messages inside that you hear when you pop them. But when Pixie decides she doesn’t want the others to hear what’s in her bubble, the chase is on to rescue it! Juniper is devastated when the traditional ceremony to celebrate her next level of spark achievement can’t happen. Kelp helps introduce a new tradition.

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Talent Show Sad Sad Plant
programme.desc: Kelp writes a song about him and Scallop to perform at the unicorn show. But when it comes time, Scallop wants to keep the song “just for them”, leaving Kelp to come up with anew act- and fast! The kids all visit the magical musical plant greenhouse on Unicorn Land. They each pick a plant to take care of, and for Kelp it’s a sad, almost dead plant that he falls in love with.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Happy Birthday Pawston
programme.desc: Tag and Scooch embark on a road trip to Chew York City to track down Kelly Korgi to ask her to perform at Pawston’s 100th birthday party.\ When Kelly Korgi tells Tag she can’t perform at Pawston’s 100th birthday party, she and Scooch decide to create a Kelly Korgi replacement so that she doesn’t break her promise to the town.

programme.title: Go, Dog. Go! S1 - Big Dog Job The Case of the Slobbery
programme.desc: Tag tries to prove to Mom that she’s a big dog by puppysitting Yip and Rhonda all day. All she has to do is get them to the playground, but the pups keep running off. \ When a giant, bone-shaped, roller coaster ride goes missing from the Amusement Bark, Detectives Tag and Scooch take on the case of the slobbery robbery.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Welcome to Harmony Harbor
programme.desc: Ari moves in to Harmony Harbor, but notices something strange involving a group of kids, a Noodle Truck chef and her pet squirrel. After Ari discovers the secret of Team Zenko Go, he asks to join the crew. But first he must learn the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Team Zenko Go S1 - Delivery Disaster Slippery Business
programme.desc: When Donna's delivery truck breaks down, it's up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbor's residents. When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Mecha-Menace
programme.desc: Magnus and Axel unveil their new "mechano-dragon." It's impressive at first, but the Riders set out to prove it's no better than a bucket of bolts.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Summer Holiday
programme.desc: In need of some rest and relaxation, the Riders head out on vacation. But their supposedly perfect island getaway isn't quite what they hoped for.

programme.title: The Mighty Ones S2 - The Night Pig Twigula
programme.desc: Kensington is terrorized by her overactive imagination when a possum comes into the yard and tangles with the Mighty Ones. Berry mistakenly thinks that Twig is a juice sucker (like vampires for berries) and tries to convince him to make her into one too.
